Name: Stephanie Bassman
Badge: Teacher as Researcher: Cultivating Literacy Routines
Looking back on this inquiry cycle, what did you learn about your teaching and your students that you might not have noticed otherwise? How did engaging in this teacher-research process shape or shift your thinking about your classroom practice?:

Different Grade levels needed different help. Not that is was surprising, but it did help me to differentiate as we moved along each day. I think they enjoyed getting to pick what they would be writing about, but did struggle to narrow it.

Share one artifact or anecdote from trying out your chosen strategy (e.g., a piece of student work, notes from your Writer’s Notebook, a classroom snapshot, or a brief story from the experience).:
View File
What new questions or next steps are you leaving this module with? How might you continue to explore or build on this inquiry in your future teaching?:

I really like the quick writes - getting students to just have quick thoughts and jot them down and later reflect on that thought and deepen it. As I use this strategy again we will focus on things related to a lesson or to aa current event, or cross teach with Social Studies or another class. I hope this would keep it relevant as we focus on things they are needing to do anyway.
